title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Jordan Reyes
commits: Initial add: rag templates and agent playbooks (Jordan Reyes)
Add python/ts quickstart examples and minimal test harness (Jordan Reyes)
Docs site: add guide + sidebar entries (Jordan Reyes)
Address review feedback: clarify auth flow, add error handling examples (Jordan Reyes)
Fix flaky example test and CI lint warnings (Jordan Reyes)
description:
Summary: Adds opinionated RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts across redwood-examples and docs to make it easier for engineers to prototype RAG-powered agents. This PR includes: templates for common RAG use-cases (customer support, knowledge base Q&A), Python and TypeScript quickstarts demonstrating tool-calling, docs site guides and sidebar updates, minimal example tests and fixtures, and a small architecture diagram for the docs site.

Motivation: We see repeated questions from customers and internal teams about how to wire Redis/Vector DBs, the Redwood API, and tool integrations together. The goal is to provide vetted, production-minded starter templates so teams can iterate faster and reduce common integration mistakes.

What I changed: 
- redwood-examples/rag/templates: two opinionated templates (customer-support-template.md, knowledge-base-template.md) with recommended prompt structure, caching hints, and rollout notes.
- redwood-examples/rag/agents: concrete quickstarts for tool-calling in Python and TypeScript showing function schemas, streaming handling, and structured output parsing.
- redwood-sdk-* examples: small copies in SDK example dirs to ensure language parity.
- redwood-docs/guides: new guide pages (rag-templates.md, tool-calling.md) with code snippets, diagrams, and recommended evaluation checks.
- docs navigation: added sidebar entries and a short architecture diagram under static images.
- tests: added a minimal pytest that validates the quickstart flow against fixtures and fixed a flaky assertion.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add templates and quickstarts in redwood-examples
- [x] Add parallel SDK examples (python/ts)
- [x] Add docs guides and sidebar updates
- [x] Add tests and CI coverage for examples
- [x] Address reviewer feedback (auth clarification, error handling)

Notes on implementation: 
- Templates are intentionally opinionated: they include recommended chunking size, embedding model choices, and a TTL caching suggestion. Each template includes a short "operational considerations" section for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Tool-calling quickstarts use a small adapter pattern to demonstrate safe tool invocation and validation of tool outputs before user-facing output.
- Authentication is shown with API key examples for hosted and a short note about KMS/HSM for Private deployments (links to security guides).

Testing & CI: CI initially reported a flaky test in examples (test_rag_quickstart.py) causing a transient failure on run #1; reran the job after adding a deterministic fixture and the pipeline passed. Linting warnings fixed in a follow-up commit.

References: Linear ENG-1289 (RAG quickstarts), PM-42 (documentation rollout). Related PRs: previous RAG docs PRs in the repo for cross-linking.

Release notes: Adds new RAG templates and agent quickstarts (Python/TypeScript) and corresponding docs. Intended for developer onboarding; no breaking API changes.
